title: Kimberly-Clark Declares $1.28 Quarterly Dividend
summary: Kimberly-Clark declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.28 per share, payable January 5, 2027, to stockholders of record on December 4, 2026.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - The board of directors of Kimberly-Clark ([KMB](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/kmb/) ) declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.28 per share on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, according to[Kimberly-Clark's official release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/kimberly-clark-declares-quarterly-dividend-302937007.html) . The dividend is payable in cash on January 5, 2027, to stockholders of record on December 4, 2026.

## What Kimberly-Clark Announced


Kimberly-Clark said its board declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.28 per share in a release issued at 5:17 p.m. ET on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The dividend is payable in cash on Tuesday, January 5, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on Friday, December 4, 2026. The release does not state an ex-dividend date.
